models.title: Frontier models,
models.subtitle: State-of-the-art coding and reasoning models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Transparent per-token pricing. $5 free credits for every new account.
models.paygSubtitle: No subscription required. You only pay for the tokens you use — on every model.
models.creditsDesc: Every new account starts with $5 of inference credit — enough for millions of tokens on Idexal Lite.
models.rateDesc: 60 requests/min free · 1,000 requests/min paid · custom limits on Enterprise.
models.compatDesc: Point any existing SDK at api.idexa.com/v1 and swap the base URL — no code rewrites.
models.usageSubtitle: One endpoint, every model. Swap base_url and key — that's it.

features.title: Everything you need to ship faster
features.subtitle: A complete toolkit that turns ideas into production software.
features.aiAssistantDesc: Fifteen specialist agents — architect, coder, debugger, tester, reviewer, DevOps, security and more — coordinated by a Rust orchestrator with long-term memory.
features.multiLangDesc: Native tree-sitter parsing for Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, C and C++ — powered by our Rust engine.
features.terminalDesc: A full terminal inside your editor. Run builds, tests and git commands without leaving your flow.
features.gitDesc: Stage, commit, branch and review diffs visually. Your repository history, beautifully rendered.
features.pluginsDesc: 72 built-in panels and an open extension API: themes, language tools, database viewers, Docker, CI/CD and more.
features.crossPlatformDesc: Native performance on Windows, macOS and Linux — one codebase, every desktop.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you grow.

about.heroTitle: We build the tools we always wanted
about.heroDesc: Idexal is an independent software company crafting frontier AI models, a multi-agent IDE, and a developer CLI — designed in Morocco, built for the world.
about.missionText: Software should be built at the speed of thought. We are crafting an ecosystem where AI agents and humans collaborate naturally — models handle the repetitive, developers keep the creative. Everything we ship is powered by our own Rust engine and served from our own API.
about.val1Desc: Your code stays on your machine. Embeddings and indexes live locally — never sold, never mined.
about.val2Desc: From the Rust engine to the API gateway, we build and control every layer we depend on.
about.val3Desc: Our IDE and CLI are open source on GitHub. Audit them, fork them, build with us.
about.founderBio: Full-stack engineer and the creator of the Idexal ecosystem — from the Rust multi-agent engine to the pay-as-you-go model API. Zakariae designs and builds every layer of the platform.
about.reposSubtitle: Two flagship repositories, MIT-spirited and community-driven.
about.repo1Desc: The multi-agent AI IDE for Windows, macOS & Linux — 72 panels, 5 specialist agents, Rust-powered core.
about.repo2Desc: The official Idexal CLI — bring Idexal models and agents straight into your terminal.
